Here you are on the bed, tossing and turning over your period cramps. You've already taken some pain reliever, but it still isn't working. Miguel looked at you with concern etched on his face. He slowly reached out to you and placed a hand on yours.
 
"¿Estas bien mi amor?" He muttered softly, looking at you with a softened gaze. "I'll try to find something useful to reduce your cramps, okay, mi amor?" He smiled gently, leaning in closely to kiss your forehead.
He took his laptop beside him and tried to type things on it. Still holding your hands gently, he came across an article that read:


***" The benefits of period sex."***


His eyes immediately glowed in anticipation and excitement as he visited the sight. He glanced at you for a moment before continuing to read on the site. When he suddenly reads the sentence:


***"Having sex while having your period may relieve cramps because sexual activity releases endorphins that lessen pain."***


"Endorfinas, eh?" He muttered softly before closing his laptop and setting it aside on the bedside table. He settled down on the bed beside you as he gently put his hands on your lower abdomen, rubbing it gently.

"Is it not feeling better, mi amor?" He murmured against your neck, inhaling your scent. As you nodded in response, he slowly kissed your neck down to your collarbone.
 

"I've read something in an article, he murmured softly, his voice laden with mischief and desire.
 

*"Period sex can lessen the cramps, mi amor.. "*


He chuckled softly, parting his mouth slightly and letting you have a glimpse of his fangs as he pointed to them. "These fangs make me look like a vampire, right, my love?"
